correctness.rationale: An exact H-description of the wheel ordinary edge polytope follows from the cycle fractional-cover dual and the explicit extreme-point classification; correct intrinsic Gram inverse I-J/(m+1) gives all distances. Dihedral averaging and crossings of active margins prove the universal optimal radius; equality conditions prove the full exceptional rectangle and uniqueness elsewhere. Full contact-facet ranks are checked through generating vertices. The standalone LP check independently tests sizes 3 through 16 and corner feasibility, without conflating finite checks with proof.

value.rationale: The ordinary wheel edge polytope is a canonical unsigned graph incidence polytope, and determining its intrinsic inball is a natural metric invariant. The complete infinite-family classification has a singular four-rim nonunique rectangle but unique centers for all other rim sizes, with explicit contact counts changing with parity; neither a cosmetic formula nor a small finite table. It supplies an interpretable sharp boundary between different controlling facet families.
